data.text: Committed and pushed at the user's request: 48ee4b91 (docs(axum): state which layers keep an inherited Batter record) on fix/in-process-routing-state-oj37, now three commits on origin/master b8747a5e; PR https://github.com/bpcakes/batter/pull/116 updated. This is the tree the converged run 1ad5e84b verified (fingerprint 8de0b6f2). Hosted CI for this commit not yet observed.

Fifth panel review (Claude + Codex, independent contexts, branch scope 48ee4b91 vs origin/master b8747a5e, fingerprint and brief verified before and after): no actionable findings from either reviewer; all thirteen brief requirements marked satisfied by both. Neither reviewer executed tests; Claude could not read dependency source outside the repository, Codex read the pinned Axum 0.8.9, axum-core 0.5.6 and http 1.5.0 sources and found the documented upstream behavior matches. Two observations Claude checked and did not report as findings: the correlation layer replaces caller-inserted RequestId/CorrelationId (pre-existing, documented), and with an inherited ObservationState but no OperationalScope the correlation layer calls replace_correlation on the earlier dispatch's shared observation state (inside the documented residual; clearing Batter-private records is a non-goal). Hosted CI on PR 116 for 48ee4b91 at report time: macOS subprocess harness, file budgets and script controls, and CI planning passed; verify (1.98.1) still pending; PR mergeable.

data.reason: InProcessClient::request now refuses, at entry and before the router or any application code is polled, a request whose extensions carry an Axum routing record (path-parameter record via RawPathParams, MatchedPath, NestedPath, OriginalUri), returning the sanitized internal failure with the public ReusedRoutingState marker and one static ERROR event; the marker is removed from every dispatched response; signature unchanged; upstream limits documented against Axum 0.8.9 and http 1.5.0. Landed on master as merge d0064cdc (PR 116: f3224582, 63c97f45, 48ee4b91). Verification: local complete scripts/verify.sh passed on the final tree; hosted CI for 48ee4b91 passed (verify 1.98.1, macOS subprocess harness, file budgets and script controls, Record verified tree; Native Runlimit PostgreSQL skipped by the planner); five panel reviews, the last with no findings. Not covered: batter_runlimit::http::TestClient (batter-gp93); Batter-private records without a detected Axum record remain accepted (documented residual); declared_dispatch benchmark not run; fresh-agent usability evaluation unexecuted.
